items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: retain SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; all four legal launch tasks remain open; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Progress is limited to partial official-source, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed because data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are missing; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed because deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are missing; capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-request procedures are missing; produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Site and checklist triage: retain site-specific remediation and evidence gates. complicated.work is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks; retain parked status until remediated. deadlymaracas.com is unreachable by DNS with unknown compliance status; retain parked status and require a concrete reachability and compliance checklist before any launch decision. The broader compliance, analytics, data-quality, site, SEO, revenue, and launch evidence supports no fleet-wide legal clearance. Preserve the aggregate $4.92 commission as unattributed and make no revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing disclosures, consent, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.
